$limitation: Two hashes, one job each (Amendment A4). surfaceHash is paired with contractVersion: if it moved, the contract surface changed and the version must bump. corpusHash is integrity only and never moves the version. NEITHER covers the rule that computes them — contract-hash.mjs is in no hashed set and cannot be, so a change to the hashing or classification rule requires REVIEW of that diff, not a green check. The classifier is exhaustive: an unclassified registry field halts hashing rather than entering a hash silently.
